candidates.title: Reopen a closed task
candidates.role: Authenticated project member with task management rights
candidates.preconditions: A task with title 'Task to Reopen' exists in project 'Test Project' and is currently closed.
candidates.gherkinScenario:
Feature: Task Lifecycle Management
  Scenario: Reopen a closed task
    Given the user is logged into Kanboard as "admin"
    And a closed task "Task to Reopen" exists in project "Test Project"
    When the user navigates to the task page for "Task to Reopen"
    And the user clicks the "Reopen this task" link in the sidebar
    And the user confirms "Yes" in the confirmation modal
    Then the task status badge displays "open"
    And searching "status:open Task to Reopen" in the project board returns the task in the board column
candidates.fixture: Setup: Create project, add task, close task. Teardown: Remove task and project.

oracle.observable: Task status changes from closed to open in database and UI badge; task reappears on active Kanban board and matches status:open query.

sourceRefs.note: open() action transitions task is_active to 1

novelty.rationale: Proposal targeting unexercised behavior beyond baseline. Baseline overlap analysis: KB-018 closes a task, and KB-027 searches closed tasks. Baseline never exercises task reopening.

baselineOverlap.rationale: KB-018 closes a task, and KB-027 searches closed tasks. Baseline never exercises task reopening.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: Reconciled with 257 features, 258 test suites, 359 assertions in bewt-original/

candidates.negativeControl: A user without task modification permission sees no 'Reopen this task' link and direct POST is rejected.

humanDecision.rationale: Human-in-the-loop batch approval by Team Lead for implementation in BEWT-CovExt v2.0 Final Completion Sprint.

candidates.title: Duplicate a task to another project

candidates.gherkinScenario:
Feature: Task Operations
  Scenario: Duplicate a task to another project
    Given the user is logged into Kanboard as "admin"
    And project "Project Alpha" contains task "Task to Clone"
    And empty project "Project Beta" exists
    When the user navigates to task "Task to Clone" in "Project Alpha"
    And the user clicks the "Duplicate to another project" link
    And the user selects "Project Beta" as destination project
    And the user clicks the "Save" button
    Then project "Project Beta" board contains task "Task to Clone"
    And original task "Task to Clone" remains intact in "Project Alpha"
